about: Mobster's brand art variants: each is a named preset for a ground, a cut and a type lockup. A blog post or a share image names one in its frontmatter with a seed and a category. Production builds render approved variants only; product/brand-art/variants.mjs enforces it. Adding a variant: docs/brand/art/README.md, 'Add a variant'. Fields: ground (kind, plate, zoom, flow), cut (null; or box 'upper' with margin and height as fractions of the frame; or box 'bleed' with [left, top, width] in percent of the frame's width and the frame's full height), calm (renderer calm zones, fractions of the frame; {band: 'bottom'} means the cut's bottom band left of its notch), grain, theme and lockup (the type layout, set as HTML over the image), and cover (the same ground as a cover with no type: its own cut and calm zones; site/tools/make-covers.mjs).

pour.description: The category's glaze plate, full bleed. The lockup top left; the meta and title bottom left, over the plate's calm lower left, with a quiet zone.
pour.seenAs: direction B, 16 Oct 2026: 'B and C look the best' and 'I just like the wordmarks and text on the abstract art bg'

lockup.cards: on use-case cards the lockup heads the bottom stack

cover.about: A cover carries no type: the plate full bleed, no calm zones.

paper-cut.description: Warm paper. The glaze shows through the cut: three bands in the upper part of the frame, the middle one slid right by the Swipe's 29%. The lockup in the top-right notch; the meta and title in ink below, on paper.
paper-cut.seenAs: direction C, 16 Oct 2026: 'B and C look the best'. The title moved off the glaze onto paper, per the owner's rule that type never sits on a streak

cover.about: A cover carries no type: the variant's cut fills the frame inside its margins, no calm zones.

night-cut.description: Neutral Night (#121212). The glaze shows only through the cut: the Swipe's three bands, the middle one slid right, placed where the frame leaves room (a banner's right half, a card's upper part). Light type on Night beside or below the cut, never on the glaze.
night-cut.seenAs: the LinkedIn cover, 16 Oct 2026: the owner picked the Night cover over pour and paper-cut, with the line 'Test and automate apps on real iPhones.' (docs/brand/social/linkedin/cover.png)

lockup.banners: on a banner the cut sits right and the title left of it, on Night

pour-cut.description: The glaze cut into the Swipe's three bands, bleeding off the left, top and bottom edges, over Night. The title on the bottom band's calm left; the lockup in the top-right notch and the meta in the bottom-right notch.

plates.about: Per-category overrides for every variant that uses a generated plate: a string swaps the plate; an object can also set its blur.
